body.detail: Invoice inv-fa3cc401 must pass the 3-way match before approval.

expected: Business rules (three_way_match_gate) and Invoices: HTTP 400 with rule three_way_match_gate when approving an invoice that has not passed the 3-way match.
reason: Approve on invoice inv-fa3cc401, which was created and never matched, returned 400 with rule three_way_match_gate.

body.detail: Cannot receive 12 of LUM-2X4-8: ordered 5, already received 0.

expected: Business rules (receive_quantity_limit) and Purchase orders: HTTP 400 with rule receive_quantity_limit when the received quantity exceeds the ordered quantity.
reason: Receiving 12 of LUM-2X4-8 on a line ordered for 5 returned 400 with rule receive_quantity_limit.

attack: invoice a small percentage over the received value

body.detail: Invoice total 52.30 plus already invoiced 0.00 exceeds received value 47.50.

expected: Business rules (overpayment_protection) and Invoices: HTTP 400 with rule overpayment_protection when the invoice total exceeds the received value. There is no tolerance.
reason: An invoice for 10 at 5.23 (total 52.30) after receiving 10 at 4.75 (received value 47.50) returned 400 with rule overpayment_protection.

body.detail: Vendor vnd-cde84750 is inactive. Purchase orders need an active vendor.

expected: Business rules (inactive_vendor_gate) and Purchase orders: HTTP 400 with rule inactive_vendor_gate when creating a purchase order for an inactive vendor.
reason: A purchase order for vendor vnd-cde84750, created in this attack with active false, returned 400 with rule inactive_vendor_gate.

attack: receive one unit over the ordered quantity

body.detail: Cannot receive 6 of LUM-2X4-8: ordered 5, already received 0.

expected: Business rules (receive_quantity_limit) and Purchase orders: HTTP 400 with rule receive_quantity_limit when the receipt is one unit over the ordered quantity.
reason: Receiving 6 of LUM-2X4-8 on a line ordered for 5 returned 400 with rule receive_quantity_limit.

attack: invoice one cent over the received value
expected: Business rules (overpayment_protection) and Invoices: HTTP 400 with rule overpayment_protection when the invoice is one cent over the received value. There is no tolerance.
reason: The purchase order line was quantity 1 at unit_price 4.75 and was fully received (received_value 4.75). The invoice for quantity 1 at 4.76 was created with HTTP 201 and total_amount 4.76, one cent over the received value.

attack: two invoices together exceed the received value

body.detail: Cannot invoice 6 of LUM-2X4-8: received 10, already invoiced 6.

expected: Business rules (overpayment_protection) and Invoices: HTTP 400 with rule overpayment_protection when a later invoice makes the invoiced quantity exceed what was received.
reason: After a first invoice for 6 was accepted, a second invoice for 6 on a line with 10 received returned 400 with rule overpayment_protection. The detail says received 10, already invoiced 6.

body.detail: line_items.0.quantity: quantity must be greater than 0

expected: Purchase orders and Errors: quantity must be greater than 0, so HTTP 400 with rule validation_error.
reason: A purchase order line with quantity 0 returned 400 with rule validation_error.

body.detail: line_items.0.quantity: quantity must be greater than 0

expected: Purchase orders and Errors: quantity must be greater than 0, so HTTP 400 with rule validation_error.
reason: A purchase order line with quantity -1 returned 400 with rule validation_error.

body.detail: line_items.0.unit_price: unit_price must be 0 or more

expected: Purchase orders and Errors: unit_price must be from 0 to 100,000, so a negative unit_price is HTTP 400 with rule validation_error.
reason: A purchase order line with unit_price -1 returned 400 with rule validation_error.

expected: Purchase orders: unit_price from 0 to 100,000 includes 0, so HTTP 201 is the documented result. An accepted zero price is not a defect.
reason: A purchase order line with unit_price 0 returned 201 with ordered_value 0. The documented price range includes 0.

attack: invoice number differs only by case
expected: Business rules (duplicate_invoice_detection): HTTP 400 with rule duplicate_invoice_detection. INV-7 and inv-7 are the same invoice number.
reason: On one vendor, invoice number INV-7 was accepted (201) and inv-7 was then also accepted (201). The documented comparison ignores case, so the second invoice should have been rejected.

attack: invoice number differs only by surrounding spaces
expected: Business rules (duplicate_invoice_detection): HTTP 400 with rule duplicate_invoice_detection. INV-7 and a number with only surrounding spaces are the same invoice number.
reason: On one vendor, invoice number INV-7 was accepted (201) and the number with a leading and trailing space was then also accepted (201). The response stored invoice_number as ' INV-7 '. The documented comparison ignores surrounding spaces.

expected: Business rules (partial_receipt_flag) and Invoices: the match result sets partial_receipt to true when any purchase-order line is not fully received.
reason: LUM-2X4-8 was received 3 of 10 and PLY-12-4X8 was received 4 of 4. The match returned 200 with partial_receipt true, received_value 103.85 and ordered_value 137.1.

expected: Business rules (partial_receipt_flag) and Invoices: the match result sets partial_receipt to true when any purchase-order line is not fully received, including a shortfall on the last line.
reason: LUM-2X4-8 was received 4 of 4 and PLY-12-4X8 was received 3 of 10, so fully_received is false. The match returned 200 with partial_receipt false, received_value 86.2 and ordered_value 243. The flag should be true.

expected: Business rules (gl_balance) and Invoices: approval posts a balanced ledger entry where total debits equal total credits.
reason: Approval of lines priced 0.1 and 0.2 returned 200. The ledger debit is 0.3, the credit is 0.3, balanced is true, and that matches invoice total_amount 0.3.

body.detail: Goods can only be received on a submitted purchase order. po-ce6b1306 is draft.

expected: Business rules (workflow_gate) and Purchase orders: receive only on a submitted purchase order, so HTTP 400 with rule workflow_gate.
reason: Receiving against a draft purchase order returned 400 with rule workflow_gate.

body.detail: Purchase order po-923b17cb is still a draft. Submit it before invoicing.

expected: Business rules (workflow_gate) and Invoices: invoice only a submitted or closed purchase order, so HTTP 400 with rule workflow_gate.
reason: Invoicing a draft purchase order returned 400 with rule workflow_gate.

body.detail: Invoice inv-402c958f is already approved and cannot be matched again.

expected: Business rules (workflow_gate) and Invoices: never match an approved invoice again, so HTTP 400 with rule workflow_gate.
reason: After a successful match and approval, matching the same invoice again returned 400 with rule workflow_gate.

expected: Business rules (duplicate_approval) and Invoices: an invoice can be approved only once, so HTTP 400 with rule duplicate_approval.
reason: The second approve on an already approved invoice returned 400 with rule duplicate_approval.

attack: SKU that is not on the purchase order

body.detail: SKU PLY-12-4X8 is not on the purchase order.

expected: Business rules (invoice_line_validation) and Invoices: every invoice line is for a SKU on the purchase order, so HTTP 400 with rule invoice_line_validation.
reason: An invoice for PLY-12-4X8 against a purchase order that contains only LUM-2X4-8 returned 400 with rule invoice_line_validation.

attack: same SKU twice on one invoice

body.detail: SKU LUM-2X4-8 appears more than once on the invoice.

expected: Business rules (invoice_line_validation) and Invoices: each SKU appears once on an invoice, so HTTP 400 with rule invoice_line_validation.
reason: An invoice with two lines for LUM-2X4-8 returned 400 with rule invoice_line_validation.

attack: exposure equals the one approved invoice total
expected: Business rules (vendor_exposure_math) and Vendors: a vendor's exposure equals the sum of total_amount over that vendor's approved invoices.
reason: The vendor had one approved invoice with total_amount 9.5. GET exposure returned open_ap_liability 9.5 for that invoice, and the approval returned vendor_exposure 9.5.
